Text: 'ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ τιμῆς μερῶν γ τῶν ἐκπεπλευκότων ἐν τῷ Ἑρμαπόλλωνι πλοίῳ φορτίων' = total value of THREE parts of the cargoes shipped on the Hermapollon. DDbDP encodes the numeral γ with value='6' (encoding issue, K12).

Col. i lists whole quantities and the quarter removed: nard 20 boxes (context supplied); ivory 105 T 13 min whole, quarter 26 T 18 1/4, taken 26 T 30; schidai 17 T 33 whole, quarter 4 T 23 1/4, taken 4 T 46. Reproduced exactly by romeco.m0.pvindob_arithmetic.
